review.verdict: Scoped clear for the registered flat-strip response, the sign of the initial widening and lengthening work at both broad waists with zero crystal prestress, and the change of sign of the welded specimen’s elastic reaction when its reference offset reverses. The shared elastic interface balances internally. The physical material reference, participating thickness, relaxed occupied shape and free-mouth acceleration remain open.
independent_checks: The four-dimensional strain Hessian was assembled on four independent principal stretches, then relaxed along the specified axes. Independent finite-element minimization of scalar order at signed curvatures checks the flat Hessian prediction with the first power of order in the modulus. The all-free and one-free transverses describe distinct preparations.

The affine triangular solver independently reconstructed the inside annulus and its displacements. It contracted Cauchy stress with the continuous widening and physical-length displacements and used the same weak reference offset. Its four force directions at the two fine broad specimens match the quadrilateral results.

The difference of the two reduced toroidal gradient forms is the radial derivative of 2 r³ f² before multiplying by the material order. The uniform feed boundary shift cancels the outgoing traction shift in the open pole operator. The signed force uses the same frozen cavity order, action and physical length differences.

Each two-sided work sum uses the carrier once, the inside and outside order once each, and the re-solved symmetric cavity wave. Zero initial elastic strain removes the first variation of material stretch there. Interior order is carried with the material chart; the exterior neutral order minimizes its energy. A subsequent re-equilibration can alter the shape work.

The joined two-band solver integrates cells on each side once, shares both displacement components and leaves them free at their common surface. Its two interfacial traction contributions cancel and signed energy derivatives give the remote-cut work. The kinematic motion of the half-order contour relative to that elastic join remains a material input.
